feedback.worked_solution:
The coordinates of the point are $(-1,0).$

- The real part of this complex number is $x=-1,$ and

- the imaginary part is $y=0.$

Therefore, the number depicted is $z=-1+0i,$ which can be simplified to $z=-1.$
